page_title: PAL 1-1 BET | Las Palmas v Betis 26/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The match has just finished.
90+3' Viti (Las Palmas) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Rui Silva intercepts the ball.
90+2' Adnan Januzaj (Las Palmas) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.

90+2' Adnan Januzaj (Las Palmas) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Corner kick. Las Palmas will have an opportunity.
90+1' Chimy Avila (Betis) commits a foul during an attacking move.
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Pejino (Las Palmas) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
88' Viti (Las Palmas) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Jose Sanchez saw the whole situation.
86' Benito Ramirez (Las Palmas) has tested the patience of referee Jose Sanchez and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
86' Pablo Fornals (Betis) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
83' Luis Carrion has decided to make a change. Adnan Januzaj (Las Palmas) replaces Alberto Moleiro.
82' Here's the change. Giovani Lo Celso leaves the pitch and Iker Losada (Betis) comes on as a substitute.
82' One of the players from Las Palmas times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.

82' Great solo effort by Pejino (Las Palmas) as he beats two defenders before unleashing a low drive from just outside of the box towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper is ready and makes a decent save.
81' Chimy Avila (Betis) bends a great shot in from the edge of the box, but Jasper Cillessen makes a smart save to deny him.
80' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
75' Substitution. Abde Ezzalzouli did his best and is replaced by Chimy Avila (Betis).
75' Substitution. Dario Essugo (Las Palmas) is replaced by Javier Munoz.
74' Here comes a substitution. Pejino is brought on as a substitute for Fabio Silva (Las Palmas).
73' Benito Ramirez (Las Palmas) announces himself with a close-range shot after a cross, but one of the defenders gets in the way of the ball to thwart him.
71' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) is caught offside!
70' Enzo Loiodice (Las Palmas) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jose Sanchez had an easy-decision to make.
69' Dario Essugo (Las Palmas) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
68' Dario Essugo (Las Palmas) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
67' One of the players from Betis times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.

66' What a great effort! Dario Essugo (Las Palmas) decides to unleash a long-range shot. Despite hitting it very well, it scorches inches wide of the left post. We could have witnessed a magnificent goal.
64' Booking. Sergi Altimira (Betis) receives a caution from the referee.
64' Here is a change. Marc Roca is going off and Manuel Pellegrini gives the last tactical orders to Sergi Altimira (Betis).
64' We are about to witness a substitution. Cedric Bakambu (Betis) is replacing Assane Diao.
62' Betis have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
62' Jose Sanchez rightly pulls out a yellow card and shows it to Jasper Cillessen (Las Palmas).
62' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Betis comes to nothing. Now Betis have a corner.
60' Jose Sanchez has a clear sight and sees a foul from Enzo Loiodice (Las Palmas).
59' Dario Essugo (Las Palmas) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
57' What was Marc Roca (Betis) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
56' Viti (Las Palmas) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
54' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) was quite harsh and Jose Sanchez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

52' Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Alberto Moleiro, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Las Palmas.
50' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
49' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) takes a mid-range shot, but it lacks accuracy and it goes way over the bar.
48' Marc Roca (Betis) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
47' The ball is cleared after Viti (Las Palmas) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Luis Carrion probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Daley Sinkgraven. He is replaced by Benito Ramirez (Las Palmas).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' 1 - 1 Goal! Assane Diao puts the ball on a plate for Giovani Lo Celso (Betis), who scores with a simple close-range finish. It's 1:1.
45+2' Oliver McBurnie (Las Palmas) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' A clumsy foul by Kirian Rodriguez (Las Palmas) and Jose Sanchez blows his whistle.
44' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Oliver McBurnie (Las Palmas) is coming onto the pitch as Sandro Ramirez cannot continue after picking up an injury.
43' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
42' Dario Essugo (Las Palmas) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
39' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the left post.
38' Kirian Rodriguez (Las Palmas) fires a powerful shot which is blocked.
37' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
33' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) makes a run into the box and gets on the end of a cross, but his well-taken shot crashes into a defender and is cleared away.
31' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Betis.
30' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. The ball goes out of play. Betis are awarded a corner kick.
30' Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) plays a one-two with Enzo Loiodice, but the move breaks down.
29' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
28' Natan (Betis) decides to take on a mid-range shot after a rebound falls into his path, but he was unbalanced and the shot subsequently goes well wide of the left post.
27' The resulting set piece from Betis is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

27' Diego Llorente (Betis) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. The ball is out of play. Betis win a corner kick.
26' A cross from the by-line finds Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) unmarked on the penalty spot, but he is unable to find the target and sends his header well wide of the left post.

23' Close! Assane Diao (Betis) is a whisker away from finishing-off the move he started. His close-range effort flies just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Las Palmas.
23' Pablo Fornals (Betis) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A fortuitous save from Jasper Cillessen stops the ball from going into the middle of the goal.
20' Daley Sinkgraven (Las Palmas) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
19' One of the players from Betis times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
15' Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
12' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Betis was in an offside position.
10' Las Palmas are ruled offside.
9' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Viti sprays a pass out to Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas), and he has an easy job to slot the ball into an empty net. The score is 1:0.
8' The linesman signals a throw-in for Betis.
5' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
5' Enzo Loiodice (Las Palmas) is penalised for holding. Jose Sanchez signals a set piece. Betis have a free kick.
4' Betis hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
2' Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) picks up a precise pass deep inside the box, but his strike is saved by the keeper.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Betis will kick-off.
Jose Sanchez will referee today's match.
